sources.name: NASA POWER Daily API
sources.intendedUse: Daily regional climate context for a requested point
sources.limitations: Gridded values are not a field weather station; local conditions may differ.

sources.name: Soil Survey Geographic Database (SSURGO)
sources.intendedUse: Mapped soil context for a U.S. pilot
sources.limitations: Map units may contain multiple components and are not exact field laboratory samples.

sources.name: Soil Data Access web service and spatial SQL functions
sources.intendedUse: Lookup map units and their possible components at a pilot coordinate
sources.limitations: Point-to-map-unit intersection gives a mapped polygon; it is not a field sampling result.

sources.name: GPM IMERG V07 half-hourly precipitation image service
sources.intendedUse: Recent satellite precipitation indicator, separate from NASA POWER history
sources.limitations: 0.1-degree gridded half-hourly estimates; the sampled value is not a field rain gauge or proof of future water availability. Service temporal availability and units must be checked on each request.

sources.name: IMERG product overview and run guidance
sources.intendedUse: Interpret IMERG as a half-hourly precipitation estimate and distinguish Early, Late, and Final runs
sources.limitations: Overview describes the product family; the app must inspect the exact service layer and returned units before treating a sample as daily accumulation.

sources.name: 2025 Iowa State Agriculture Overview
sources.intendedUse: Identify major Iowa crops; state figures are not county or field suitability
sources.limitations: State aggregate, not specific to central Iowa

sources.name: 2024 Iowa Crop Progress Review
sources.intendedUse: Broad Iowa planting and harvest season context
sources.limitations: One-year state report, not a date prescription

sources.name: Cover Crop Resources
sources.intendedUse: Iowa corn-soy cover-crop patterns
sources.limitations: Beginner recipes need adaptation to local management

sources.name: Most Commonly Used Cover Crops in Iowa
sources.intendedUse: Cover crop types, overwintering, and management tradeoffs
sources.limitations: General Iowa guidance, not field-specific performance

sources.name: Types of Cover Crops for Use in Home Vegetable Gardens
sources.intendedUse: Species identity and qualitative cover-crop traits only
sources.limitations: Home vegetable gardens are a different management system from commercial row crops; do not transfer ratings directly into recommendation scores

sources.name: Iowa Cover Crop Recipe: Post Corn, Going to Soybean
sources.owner: Iowa State University Extension and Midwest Cover Crops Council
sources.intendedUse: Central Iowa cereal rye timing and corn-to-soybean cover window
sources.limitations: Introductory recipe, not an exact planting date for every field

sources.name: Terminating cover crops ahead of corn
sources.intendedUse: Potential corn establishment and disease risks after winter cereal rye
sources.limitations: Risk depends on termination, weather, and management

sources.name: Influence of Drought on Corn and Soybean
sources.intendedUse: Qualitative crop-stage water sensitivity
sources.limitations: Does not provide field water needs from annual rainfall alone

sources.name: Soil-test interpretations for liming decisions
sources.intendedUse: Conditional Iowa pH targets for corn, soybean, and alfalfa
sources.limitations: Corn/soy target depends on subsoil; not a universal pH range

sources.name: Floods
sources.intendedUse: Regional flood and erosion context
sources.limitations: Hazard description does not establish individual field risk

sources.name: July 2025 Weather Update
sources.intendedUse: Example of rainfall and dryness variability
sources.limitations: One period is not a long-term climate trend

sources.name: Adding alfalfa benefits corn-soybean rotations
sources.intendedUse: Upper Midwest diversified rotation pattern and potential benefits
sources.limitations: Minnesota trial and management systems may not transfer directly to a central Iowa field

sources.name: Value of crop rotation in nitrogen management
sources.intendedUse: Qualitative Iowa rotation and nitrogen context
sources.limitations: Does not establish a crop-specific field nitrogen credit

sources.name: Understanding rye cover crop effects on corn
sources.intendedUse: Rye biomass and water/nitrogen management tradeoffs
sources.limitations: Research synthesis cannot predict field-specific outcome

sources.name: USDA ARS Cover Crop Chart, version 4.0
sources.intendedUse: Qualitative crop type and relative water use
sources.limitations: Broad species-level chart, not local water requirement or field outcome

sources.name: Oilseed radish Plant Guide
sources.intendedUse: Radish growing period and taproot context
sources.limitations: Guide draws on multiple regions; local Iowa feasibility still requires review

sources.name: MODIS Vegetation Indices
sources.intendedUse: Potential vegetation-greenness context
sources.limitations: Greenness is not crop identity, yield, or direct soil health.

sources.name: SoilGrids
sources.intendedUse: Potential modeled global soil context after a stable access method is validated
sources.limitations: ISRIC currently says its beta REST API is paused. WCS and WebDAV are alternatives but have not been integrated or validated here. Modeled estimates include spatial and prediction uncertainty.

sources.name: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6
sources.intendedUse: Potential long-term climate-scenario comparison
sources.limitations: Climate scenarios are not next-season weather forecasts.
